decisions.reason: As a reworked and publicly renamed trommel screen in a core screening segment, it builds on prior acceptance and the firm is likely to stay committed to it rather than abandon that investment quickly.

The flail shredder line was still being updated and showcased with Stage V technology, indicating visible ongoing commitment in a central mobile-machinery category that management would be reluctant to reverse.

The grinder gained stronger standalone presentation after launch and fits the firm's strategic push in mobile waste-processing equipment, so management would likely interpret any weaker traction as temporary and continue.

The CERON pre-shredder line received strong public claims, dedicated presentation, and reference use, making it a highly committed stationary product family that management is very unlikely to withdraw in the near term.
